reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific application of high-pressure SPS to create a graded interface in W-Cu composite joints for fusion-relevant conditions, which is not reported in any passage. While individual elements like SPS densification and Cu network formation are known, the combination of SPS as a single-step intervention to overcome phase separation and void formation at a joint interface, with a falsification test under heat-transfer and irradiation, goes beyond the existing literature.
copied_elements: SPS enhances densification (P2, P5, P6, P8)
SPS forms a continuous Cu network (P2, P8)
Conventional sintering leads to voids and phase separation (P1, P3, P11, P15, P16)
Thermal conductivity is linked to Cu network and densification (P1, P2, P9)
